title: Share of US counties with Lyme-carrying blacklegged ticks

source.name: County-level distribution of blacklegged ticks carrying Lyme bacteria
source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

notes: CDC tick-surveillance data: blacklegged ticks capable of carrying Lyme bacteria were documented in about 30% of US counties in 1998, versus roughly 45% in the most recent nationwide survey, as milder winters and longer breeding seasons expand the tick's range northward and to higher elevation.
